payload.core_mechanism_summary: 1D DP on value frequency array where state i considers taking value i and adds max of states i-2 and i-3 to avoid adjacent deletions.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 1D array t where t[i] initially holds total points for value i, then iteratively t[i] += max(t[i-2], t[i-3]), effectively implementing a take/no-take DP with a 2-step skip. This is classic 1D DP, not 2D.
